nodes.summary: Uniformly contractive operators that are Cauchy on a dense set are Cauchy everywhere.
nodes.title: Cauchy property of uniform contractions extends from a dense set

nodes.summary: For every continuous `f`, the sequence `(wfStep M)^⌊tM⌋ f` is Cauchy in `C([0, 1], ℝ)`: it converges on the dense set of polynomials and the operators are contractions.
nodes.title: Rescaled Wright–Fisher iterates form a Cauchy sequence

nodes.summary: Weierstrass approximation: polynomial functions are dense in `C([0, 1], ℝ)`.
nodes.title: Weierstrass approximation theorem on the unit interval

nodes.summary: The dual moment polynomial `∑_k P_t(n → k) X^k`, where for `t ≥ 0`, `P_t(n → k) = exp (t • G) n k` is the probability that `n` lineages of Kingman's coalescent have `k` ancestors time `t` earlier (time in units of `M = 2N` generations); evaluated at `x` it is `E_n[x^{A_t}]` for the block-counting process `A`.
nodes.title: Dual moment polynomial of Kingman's coalescent

nodes.summary: `polyGenerator` is the neutral Wright–Fisher generator `generator 0` evaluated on `p`.
nodes.title: Polynomial generator agrees with the neutral Wright–Fisher generator

nodes.summary: If `t ≤ 0`, then the natural floor of `t * M` is zero.
nodes.title: Natural floor of a nonpositive multiple is zero

nodes.summary: At every positive time, differentiating the existing Wright–Fisher semigroup on a polynomial equals applying the semigroup to its generator.
nodes.title: Polynomial semigroup dynamics

nodes.summary: If the allele count after one neutral Wright–Fisher generation with `M ≥ 1` gene copies is `Bin(M, x)`, then `E_x[(X₁)^n] = ∑_k wfLineageProb M n k · x^k`, where `X₁` is the new frequency and `wfLineageProb M n k` is the probability that `n` genes have `k` distinct parents.
nodes.title: Moment duality, one generation

nodes.summary: Kernel form of Wright–Fisher moment duality: transition-kernel moments are the transition probabilities of Kingman's block-counting process.
nodes.title: Kernel form of Wright–Fisher moment duality

nodes.summary: Integration against the transition kernel agrees with the Wright–Fisher semigroup on every continuous test function and every initial allele frequency.
nodes.title: Wright–Fisher transition kernel represents the semigroup

nodes.summary: `sup_{[0,1]} |wfSemigroup t f| ≤ sup_{[0,1]} |f|`.
nodes.title: Contraction

nodes.summary: One Wright–Fisher generation is a contraction for the sup norm.
nodes.title: One Wright–Fisher generation is a sup-norm contraction

nodes.summary: Any number of Wright–Fisher generations is a contraction for the sup norm.
nodes.title: Iterated Wright–Fisher generations are sup-norm contractions

nodes.summary: The neutral Wright–Fisher generator on polynomials, `x (1 - x) / 2 · p''`.
nodes.title: Neutral Wright–Fisher generator on polynomials

nodes.summary: Semigroup law on polynomials, from `exp ((s + t) • G) = exp (t • G) * exp (s • G)` and truncation consistency; holds for all real `s`, `t`.
nodes.title: Semigroup law

nodes.summary: The dual semigroup fixes the constant polynomial `1` (zero lineages stay zero).
nodes.title: Dual semigroup fixes the constant polynomial one

nodes.summary: The dual semigroup on a monomial is the dual moment polynomial.
nodes.title: Dual semigroup on a monomial

nodes.summary: At time `0` the dual semigroup is the identity.
nodes.title: Dual semigroup at time zero is the identity

nodes.summary: The neutral Wright–Fisher diffusion semigroup on polynomials, defined by moment duality on the monomial basis: `polySemigroup t (X ^ n) = dualMomentPoly t n`. It is meaningful for `t ≥ 0`; the formula is defined, and the group law holds, for every real `t`.
nodes.title: Wright–Fisher semigroup on polynomials by moment duality

nodes.summary: Every power of a continuous linear endomorphism fixing `1` also fixes `1`.
nodes.title: Powers of a unital endomorphism fix the constant function

nodes.summary: Every power of a positive continuous linear endomorphism is positive.
nodes.title: Powers of a positive endomorphism are positive

nodes.summary: For `M ≥ 1` gene copies, `∑_i C(M, i) x^i (1 - x)^(M - i) (i/M)^n = ∑_k S(n, k) M_(k) / M^n · x^k`: the `n`-th moment of the frequency after one generation equals the generating function of the number of distinct parents of `n` sampled genes. Holds for every real `x`.
nodes.title: Moment duality, one generation (polynomial identity)

nodes.summary: Limits of uniformly contractive operators extend from a dense set to the whole space.
nodes.title: Limits of uniform contractions extend from a dense set

nodes.summary: `wfSemigroup t f → f` uniformly as `t → 0⁺`, for every continuous `f`.
nodes.title: Strong continuity

nodes.summary: For every polynomial `p`, `(wfSemigroup t p - p) / t → x (1 - x) / 2 · p''` uniformly on `[0, 1]` as `t → 0⁺`.
nodes.title: Generator on polynomials

nodes.summary: For `t ≥ 0` and every polynomial `p`, `⌊tM⌋` generations of the Wright–Fisher chain with `M` gene copies applied to `p` converge uniformly on `[0, 1]` to `polySemigroup t p` as `M → ∞` (moment duality plus Kingman's theorem for the lineage count).
nodes.title: Convergence on polynomials

nodes.summary: For every continuous `f`, `⌊tM⌋` generations of the neutral Wright–Fisher chain with `M` gene copies applied to `f` converge uniformly on `[0, 1]` to `wfSemigroup t f`.
nodes.title: Diffusion approximation of the transition operators (Trotter–Kato, concrete form)

nodes.summary: Semigroup law for `s, t ≥ 0`.
nodes.title: Semigroup law

nodes.summary: The diffusion semigroup fixes constants (it is Markov: total mass `1`).
nodes.title: Wright–Fisher diffusion semigroup fixes constants

nodes.summary: The fourth centered increment of the neutral Wright–Fisher semigroup satisfies the uniform Kolmogorov bound `T_t[(y-x)⁴](x) ≤ (3/16)t²`.
nodes.title: Fourth-moment Kolmogorov bound for the Wright–Fisher semigroup

nodes.summary: The diffusion semigroup maps nonnegative functions to nonnegative functions.
nodes.title: Positivity

nodes.summary: For `t ≤ 0`, `wfSemigroup t` is the identity (at `t = 0` by definition of a semigroup; for `t < 0` this is a junk value of the definition).
nodes.title: Wright–Fisher semigroup at nonpositive times is the identity

nodes.summary: The positive-operator form of the Wright–Fisher semigroup law.
nodes.title: Semigroup law for the positive Wright–Fisher operator

nodes.summary: The positive Wright–Fisher operator fixes the constant function `1`.
nodes.title: Positive Wright–Fisher operator fixes constants

nodes.summary: Bundling the operator as positive leaves its action on continuous functions unchanged.
nodes.title: Action of the positive Wright–Fisher operator

nodes.summary: The Wright–Fisher semigroup bundled as a positive continuous linear operator.
nodes.title: Wright–Fisher semigroup as a positive operator

nodes.summary: The centered second moment grows at most linearly: `T_t[(y-x)²](x) ≤ t/4`.
nodes.title: Second-moment bound for the Wright–Fisher semigroup

nodes.summary: On polynomials the diffusion semigroup is the dual semigroup, for `t ≥ 0`.
nodes.title: Diffusion semigroup agrees with the dual semigroup on polynomials

nodes.summary: Moment duality for the diffusion (Ethier & Griffiths 1993). For `t ≥ 0`, the semigroup applied to `x ↦ x ^ n` is `∑_k P_t(n → k) x^k`, with `P_t = exp (t • G)` the transition matrix of Kingman's block-counting process `A`; in process language `E_x[(X_t)^n] = E_n[x^{A_t}]` (the processes themselves are not constructed here).
nodes.title: Moment duality for the diffusion

nodes.summary: At time `0` the diffusion semigroup is the identity.
nodes.title: Wright–Fisher diffusion semigroup at time zero is the identity

nodes.summary: The neutral Wright–Fisher diffusion semigroup on `C([0, 1], ℝ)`, time in units of `M = 2N` generations: `wfSemigroup t f` is the uniform limit of `(wfStep M)^⌊tM⌋ f` as `M → ∞` (`tendsto_wfStep_pow_floor`). For `t < 0` it is the identity (a junk value: `⌊tM⌋₊ = 0`).
nodes.title: Neutral Wright–Fisher diffusion semigroup

nodes.summary: One Wright–Fisher generation fixes the constant function `1`.
nodes.title: One Wright–Fisher generation fixes constants

nodes.summary: `wfStep M` is the Bernstein approximation operator.
nodes.title: Wright–Fisher step is the Bernstein operator

nodes.summary: One Wright–Fisher generation maps nonnegative functions to nonnegative functions.
nodes.title: One Wright–Fisher generation preserves nonnegativity

nodes.summary: For `M ≥ 1` and `n ≤ N`, `m` generations of the Wright–Fisher chain map `x ^ n` to `∑_k ((wfLineageMatrix N M)^m) n k · x^k`: the `n`-th moment of the frequency after `m` generations is the generating function of the number of ancestors, `m` generations back, of `n` sampled genes.
nodes.title: Moment duality, `m` generations

nodes.summary: One generation maps `x ^ n` to `∑_k wfLineageProb M n k x ^ k`.
nodes.title: One Wright–Fisher generation acting on monomials

nodes.summary: One generation of the neutral Wright–Fisher chain with `M` gene copies, acting on continuous functions of the allele frequency: `(wfStep M f)(x) = ∑_k f(k/M) C(M, k) x^k (1 - x)^(M - k)`, which for `M ≥ 1` is the expected value of `f` at the next frequency `Bin(M, x) / M` (the `M`-th Bernstein operator, Mathlib's `bernsteinApproximation`; the expectation is `ProbabilityTheory.integral_binomial`). It is a linear…
nodes.title: One generation of the neutral Wright–Fisher chain

nodes.summary: Chapman–Kolmogorov law for the Wright–Fisher transition kernels. With Mathlib's convention, `K_t ∘ₖ K_s` first evolves for time `s` and then for time `t`.
nodes.title: Chapman–Kolmogorov equation for the Wright–Fisher diffusion

nodes.summary: For nonpositive times, the Wright–Fisher transition is the identity kernel.
nodes.title: Wright–Fisher transition kernel is the identity at nonpositive times

nodes.summary: Pointwise identity law for the transition kernel at time zero.
nodes.title: Wright–Fisher transitions at time zero are Dirac masses

nodes.summary: At time zero the Wright–Fisher transition is the identity kernel.
nodes.title: Wright–Fisher transition kernel is the identity at time zero

nodes.summary: The transition kernel of the neutral Wright–Fisher diffusion at time `t`. For nonnegative `t` it is the probabilistic transition corresponding to `wfSemigroup t`; for negative `t`, both the operator and kernel are the identity junk value inherited from `wfSemigroup`.
nodes.title: Transition kernel of the neutral Wright–Fisher diffusion

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
